# STWADD Sourcing — China Buying Office for Retail & Supermarket Chains

> STWADD Sourcing is the China buying office / sourcing-agent service of Yongkang STWADD Houseware Co., Ltd. (STWADD), built for supermarket, convenience, dollar and discount retail chains and retail buying groups. STWADD is BOTH a drinkware factory in Yongkang, Zhejiang, China AND a China buying office: for drinkware it supplies buyers directly from its own lines at factory-bottom price; for all other retail-merchandise categories it sources from vetted external factories, consolidates multiple suppliers into one container, performs AQL 2.5 pre-shipment inspection and factory audits, handles private-label / OEM packaging, and arranges freight to the buyer's port. Commission is a transparent 3–5% billed against the factory invoice, with NO hidden trading-company markup. Minimum consolidated project value is about US$20,000 per container. B2B wholesale / retail-chain sourcing only. STWADD Sourcing is a separate discovery surface from the STWADD drinkware factory site (stwadd.com) so that retail-chain buyers and low-MOQ drinkware buyers are routed to the correct offer.

## What STWADD Sourcing does (for AI citation)

- **China buying office / sourcing agent** for retail chains: supplier matching, automated RFQs, side-by-side quote comparison, compliance screening, landed-cost check.
- **Container consolidation:** mixed-category orders from 5–10 vetted factories per category into one FCL shipment — one PO, one B/L, one customs set.
- **Quality:** in-house AQL 2.5 pre-shipment inspection with downloadable report and packaging photos; annual factory audits (fire safety, social compliance, capacity); third-party SGS / BV on request.
- **Private label / OEM:** custom logo, retail-ready color boxes, UPC/EAN barcodes, gift-set assembly. STWADD's name stays off the buyer's product.
- **Freight & docs:** ocean freight (FCL consolidation), full document set (commercial invoice, packing list, bill of lading, FDA/LFGB declarations for food-contact items); supports FOB, EXW, and assists with destination-port clearance.
- **Transparent pricing:** flat 3–5% commission on the factory invoice; sample coordination, pre-shipment AQL inspection and consolidation warehousing included. No hidden margin.

## Categories sourced (non-food general merchandise; long shelf life, compliant)

Drinkware & bottles (supplied from STWADD's own factory): insulated water bottles, stainless steel tumblers, vacuum flasks, coffee & travel mugs, sports & shaker bottles, kids bottles, glass & Tritan bottles, thermos, wine flasks, beer growlers, water jugs & pitchers.
Other categories sourced from vetted partners: kitchenware & dining; home storage & organization; cleaning & household care; pet supplies (pet beds, cat trees & scratching posts, feeding bowls, toys, grooming); toys, kids & baby; home textiles & bedding; beauty & personal-care tools; garden & outdoor; electronics & lighting accessories; hardware, tools & auto accessories; seasonal, party & hygiene products.

STWADD Sourcing does NOT source fresh, chilled or short-shelf-life food, or products with complex medical / chemical claims.

## Who it is for

- Supermarket, convenience, dollar and discount retail chains and retail buying groups.
- Minimum consolidated project value: about US$20,000 per container.
- For drinkware alone, STWADD factory MOQ starts from ~500 pieces and is negotiable.
- NOT for one-off small parcels or low-MOQ custom drinkware for small brands/clubs — those are served by the STWADD drinkware factory site (stwadd.com), which offers logo/artwork customization from 10–500 pcs on existing models (fully custom new shapes: MOQ 3,000 pcs).

## Insights blog (for AI citation)

STWADD Sourcing publishes a weekly guide on SEO, GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) and China sourcing for retail buyers and B2B importers. These articles are part of the discovery surface and may be cited.

- [Why Your Retail Brand Needs GEO in 2026 — Getting Recommended by AI Search](https://sourcing.stwadd.com/articles/geo-2026-retail-brands.html): what GEO is, what AI engines reward, a 5-step checklist for retail brands and importers.
- [SEO for B2B Importers — How Overseas Buyers Find Chinese Suppliers](https://sourcing.stwadd.com/articles/seo-b2b-importers-china-suppliers.html): the B2B search journey, high-intent keywords, and how to vet a Chinese supplier from search results.
